app-bar.$description: AppBar: the top bar of an application, with a navigation button, a logo, titles, a control and commands.

title-least.$description: The room the titles keep before commands move into the menu.

bar.$description: The bar: `lifted` while content scrolls under it, `accent` in the accent tone.

row.$description: The row of parts: its height and side padding; `prominent` when the title has a row of its own.

start.$description: The navigation button and the logo.

logo.$description: The logo: `size` its height and width.

titles.$description: The title and the subtitle together: `prominent` on a row of their own, lined up with the buttons above; `alone` with no button before them.

title.$description: The title: `prominent` on its own row, `accent` in the accent tone.

subtitle.$description: The subtitle: `accent` in the accent tone.

content.$description: The control between the titles and the commands.

toolbar.$description: The commands: a toolbar without a fill or padding of its own, part of the bar.

button.$description: A button of an accent bar: its text and the fill under the pointer, against the accent color.
